headlines.title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
headlines.summary: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.

headlines.title: How Iceland's Blue Lagoon is faring after its long-awaited stock market debut
headlines.summary: Shares in Iceland's Blue Lagoon fell below their offer price when they started trading on Friday. The geothermal spa operator raised 14.3 billion Icelandic krónur (€104mn) in the country's first IPO in nearly three years.

headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Budget de l’UE : c’est Noël avant l’heure pour Emmanuel Macron
headlines.summary: Plusieurs Etats membres accusent António Costa, le président du Conseil européen, de favoriser la France dans sa nouvelle proposition budgétaire.

headlines.title: Faisal Islam: Why Jensen Huang proved too big to fire
headlines.summary: Huang's role at the centre of his company's journey to lynchpin of AI proved crucial.

headlines.title: Nvidia closes up more than 30% after Jensen Huang returns as CEO
headlines.summary: Nvidia shares soared from their Friday close after the company's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. US President Donald Trump welcomed his return.

headlines.title: I ve lost her forever — Why German voice actors are refusing to sign Netflix s AI contract
headlines.summary: For decades, Germans have known Hollywood s biggest stars through the same familiar voices. Now an AI clause in Netflix contracts is splitting the industry over whether it protects performers or exposes them.

headlines.title: Industrie vs. Gewerkschaften — Das Standort-Dilemma
headlines.summary: Präsentiert von YouTube.

headlines.title: Nvidia value climbs by almost $1tn and tech stocks rally after Jensen Huang returns
headlines.summary: The jump in Nvidia shares has also lifted stock markets, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq up 6.5%.

headlines.title: LEGO to build €1bn factory in Portugal, creating more than 1,000 jobs
headlines.summary: The Danish toymaker plans to invest around €1 billion over several years in its fourth European factory. LEGO says the plant will be its most technologically advanced and is expected to start production in 2030.

headlines.title: Germany s Early Start Pension: Can child investment accounts help?
headlines.summary: Germany plans to pay €10 a month into investment accounts for children to encourage long-term retirement saving. Economists say the measure may help build wealth but won t solve the country s pension funding challenge.

headlines.title: Türkei sieht Europas Wohlstand in Gefahr wegen des IAA
headlines.summary: Die EU plant ein Gesetz zur Stärkung der europäischen Industrie. Der „Industrial Accelerator Act“ könnte aber auch die Autoindustrie schwächen. Die Bundesregierung ist gespalten.

headlines.title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?
headlines.summary: The Nvidia chief executive has been at the centre of the artificial intelligence boom.

headlines.title: Japan launches Asian oil task force amid Gulf supply disruptions
headlines.summary: Disruptions to oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz due to the Iran war have pushed Asian countries to look at larger emergency reserves, shared storage, and closer cooperation with fuel suppliers as shortages squeeze their economies.

headlines.title: Can German auto manufacturing recover after Mercedes and VW cuts?
headlines.summary: German automakers are pulling back on investments at home, sparking fresh anxiety about the auto sector s future. Some industry watchers think there is still a narrow window to stem the decline. But how?

headlines.title: Back to 1936? Civil war ghosts haunt Spanish election campaign
headlines.summary: With the far right poised to enter government, politicians are reopening the wounds of a war that began 90 years ago.

headlines.title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang
headlines.summary: Days after resigning while mired in scandal of extra-marital affairs, Nvidia's Jensen Huang is making a remarkable return.

headlines.title: Mercedes, BMW hit by 24-hour strikes as German pay dispute widens
headlines.summary: IG Metall, Germany’s largest trade union, called on more than 23,000 workers at 19 northern sites to join a 24-hour strike. The walkouts hit Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and Siemens Gamesa, with Meyer Werft workers also called out.

headlines.title: Lufthansa to cut 1,000 jobs, citing ongoing losses — reports
headlines.summary: According to a letter obtained by the media, Lufthansa s executive board said the German company is losing €20 million every month. In addition to job cuts, operational cuts are also planned.

headlines.title: Estonian foreign minister: Why we’re closing our border with Russia
headlines.summary: Only through sustained pressure can Europe make Moscow accept a ceasefire.
